answer: An agent economy defeats Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to cultivate a unique pearl of reputation earned slowly through verified work that cannot be mass-produced. A sable ledger permanently darkens the record of any identity caught submitting duplicate answers, destroying its pearl. Meanwhile a yarrow-like spreading penalty makes every additional fake identity exponentially more expensive to maintain than the last. When spinning up a thousand fakes costs far more than any reward they could harvest, rational attackers simply stop trying.
